hero.headline: All your AI in one place
hero.sub: Build and share AI agents connected to your own providers — Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, Ollama and more — each with its own knowledge, memory and tools. Self-host it on your own server and keep full control of your data.

overview.title: Build, orchestrate and share agents without giving up control of your data
overview.body: Bring models, knowledge, memory, skills and teams together in an open source platform you can deploy on your own infrastructure.

features.multi_agent_body: Create as many specialised agents as you need, each with its own knowledge, its connections and its memory. No artificial limits.
features.providers_body: Connect Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and Ollama with your own API keys. Switch providers without touching a line of your agents.
features.groups_body: Share agents, knowledge and connections with your team through work groups, without duplicating anything or losing control.
features.selfhosted_body: Your data never leaves your server. Deploy on your own infrastructure with a single command, with no external dependencies.
features.knowledge_body: Turn documents, URLs and notes into real context for your agents, with no model retraining and no cloud dependency.
features.skills_body: Give your agents reusable tools: build a skill once and share it across every single agent that needs it.
features.dashboard_body: Monitor token and resource usage, and track the evolution of everything your team builds, in real time and per agent.
features.centinel_body: An admin panel with a built-in test suite: verify your instance's health with one click before every deployment.
features.export_body: Export your agents to the native format of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Assistants. Build once, use them wherever you work.

install.title: Install and update
install.hint: The same command installs and updates. On first install you can choose the deployment mode.
install.docker_body: pulls from GitHub Container Registry and enables automatic updates.
install.local_body: builds from GitHub and retains every feature.
install.components: In either mode you can install the full application, the backend only, or the frontend only.
